subject: Post-demo model scorecard & action plan — Stellar Retail POC
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo model scorecard & action plan — Stellar Retail POC

Hi Marina,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — really appreciated the candid feedback on the sample prompts and the two example failure modes you showed. Per our discussion, I've attached a lightweight scorecard and an action plan that should help the team pick the best candidate for your customer-facing Q&A and product summarization flows.

Quick TL;DR (see attached CSV for numbers):
- Recommendation: Run a 2-week A/B evaluation between "rw-3.5-large" (quantized) and "OpenLLaMA-13B-q4".
- Why those two: rw-3.5-large gives best observed F1/ROUGE-style quality on your retail prompts (median improvement ~7%), with 25–40% higher cost vs OpenLLaMA. OpenLLaMA-13B-q4 has better cost per 1M tokens (~$85 vs $120) and lower 95p latency in our hosted baseline (145ms vs 220ms for rw-3.5-large).
- Fast fallback: keep a compact 6B variant (gptj-6B-8bit) as an automatic fallback for peak windows — ~35% cheaper and 2x throughput, but with occasional hallucination on product specs.

Attachments included: 20260224_stellar_model_scorecard.csv (benchmarks + prompt-level deltas), prompt-set-stellar.zip (your supplied prompts + 50 synthetic edge cases), l1_latency_bench.png (latency curves).

Open questions I'd like you to confirm so we can spin up the eval environment:
1) Can we get a 2-week evaluation window starting next Monday (Mar 2)?
2) Do you want the eval run on Redwood Hosted or Dedicated capacity? (Hosted is fastest to start; Dedicated will be required for SLA/throughput guarantees and can be provisioned after initial results).
3) Any legal/procurement constraints on data retention or log exports during the POC?

Next steps I propose (if you agree):
- Monday: Redwood provisions two concurrent endpoints (rw-3.5-large q4 + OpenLLaMA-13B-q4) and deploys the prompt set. (Owner: Aditya)
- Week 1: Run automatic scoring (our harness + your QA feedback) and produce interim quality report. (Owner: Monica)
- Week 2: Ramp production traffic slice, finalize SLA draft and procurement. (Owner: Priyom / Procurement)

If that sounds reasonable, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short onboarding doc for your engineering lead.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri y.om@redwood.ai
From: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@stellarretail.com>

Thanks, Priyom — this is helpful and much appreciated. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- The quality numbers look promising, but our security team will require information about what gets logged during the eval. Can you confirm if we can turn off persistent content logs and only capture aggregated telemetry for the POC?
- Procurement: we prefer to start with Hosted for speed, but will likely require Dedicated if economics look good. Can you provide a short note on estimated monthly costs for both Hosted (baseline traffic ~100k tokens/day) and Dedicated (95th pct throughput 200 reqs/min)?

Also copying in our procurement email to loop them in. If you can provide the cost note and logging controls, we can confirm the March 2 start.

—Marina
VP, Product Innovation | Stellar Retail

Priyom / Aditya,

I reviewed the scorecard and the prompt set. I can own the week-1 and week-2 quality reports and will run the eval harness. A few operational notes:

- Logging controls: We can disable persistent transcript storage for the POC and only emit aggregated telemetry (latency, token counts, top-level error codes). For any troubleshooting we’d enable ephemeral debug logging for a narrow window and scrub PII; Marina's security team will get a runbook.
- Cost estimates (very rough): Hosted baseline (100k tokens/day): ~$2,500/month for the OpenLLaMA-13B-q4 config; rw-3.5-large ~ $3,600/month at the same traffic profile. Dedicated pricing depends on commit size, but for a minimal Dedicated pool sized for 200 reqs/min expect ~$18k/month with a 3-month minimum. I'll push a short cost memo into the Drive link.
- Metric checklist for eval: exact-match accuracy, ROUGE-L, hallucination rate (false product facts), 95p latency, and tokens per second. We should prioritize hallucination rate for product spec correctness.

Operational ask: Aditya, can you provision two endpoints in the dev environment and drop the API keys in the shared onboarding doc? I'll run the first pass of the harness on Wed.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@stellarretail.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Great — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming next steps and owners: 

1) Provisioning (Owner: Aditya) — deploy rw-3.5-large (quantized) + OpenLLaMA-13B-q4 endpoints in our Hosted dev environment by EOD Friday (Feb 27). Drop keys to the onboarding doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcScorecardStellar
2) Eval harness (Owner: Monica) — run baseline scoring Wed/Thu and share interim report by Friday (Mar 1). Use the attached prompt-set-stellar.zip and include the top-50 customer live prompts + 50 edge cases.
3) Procurement & SLA (Owner: Priyom / Stellar Procurement) — I’ll circulate the SLA draft and a Hosted vs Dedicated cost appendix by Thursday.

A couple of notes on risk and mitigations: 
- Quality regression: we will track running baseline on your historical sample set; any model that shows >5% regression on exact-match or >10% regression on ROUGE-L vs your control will be flagged and quarantined automatically. We will surface examples in the report.
- Fallback policy: configured to failover to gptj-6B-8bit under sustained queueing, and to switch to a cheaper model during scheduled sales peaks per your config.

I’ll send calendar invites for the provisioning and the mid-eval checkpoint. If procurement wants a budget line-item for Dedicated sizing to review with finance, I’ll prepare that tomorrow.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
